text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $64.7k with minimal daily movement, while Ethereum is outperforming with a 1.8% gain, suggesting some rotation toward altcoins despite extreme fear conditions. The Fear & Greed index at 25 reflects deep pessimism, yet moderate volume of $55B and Bitcoin's stable dominance at 56.7% indicate this isn't capitulative selling—the market is consolidating rather than collapsing. The divergence between Bitcoin's flatness and Ethereum's strength, combined with declining sentiment, suggests cautious positioning ahead rather than panic liquidation.
